inherited_mechanisms: P2 review is not automatic promotion
new_unadopted_hypotheses: same-distance-if-present sample selection; other FNB distance fallback explicitly prior
historical normalized position envelope as a possible future-position prior, not measured current range
trajectory displacement as six separate cost proxies, not physiological measurement
historical acquisition-interval overlap as congestion proxy, never current FSD density or intention
Pareto layers over role-specific vectors; nondominated fronts are semantic proposals, not purchase instructions
head-specific overlap dimension for P2; head/second World-overlap dimension for Third

raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.FPR_acquisition: min/max/median first printed position shares; a prior hypothesis, not today's measured acceleration
raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.LCC_acquisition_count: count(first printed position ==1); denominator selected observed rows
raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.LCC_maintenance_count: count(first printed position == last printed position ==1); denominator selected observed rows
raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.FSD_interval_relation: two historical acquisition intervals overlap inclusively; unknown intention and current density remain NULL
raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.Stage_Absorption: sum(max(next_share-previous_share,0)); backward movement proxy, not causal contest resistance
raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.Reachable_envelopes: separate min/max/median over historical first, last, finish; hypotheses only; corner3/corner4=NULL
raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.World: first=last=1 -> LEAD_HOLD; else any forward movement -> PROGRESSION; else TRACK_OR_HOLD; no actual tactical-intention claim
raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.Pareto: a dominates b iff all role dimensions a<=b and at least one a<b; remove nondominated fronts iteratively
raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.P2_head_collision: append indicator(target interval overlaps head interval) to candidate P2 vector
raw_to_hypothesis_formulas.Third_pair_world: append indicator(target World set intersects head-or-second World set) to candidate P3 vector

P2: hypothetical last reported interval upper endpoint

parameters.pareto_selection: nondominated first front; all layers retained; ties and missing rank intervals retained

missing: unknown metrics stay null and rank interval1..N; unresolved W/P2/P3 and Head/Pair/Third paths retained explicitly, no synthetic score or forced ticket
PRE_KRS: existing HSV/static numeric arrays unchanged; candidate Role/Pair/Third/World draft bound by SHA; no claim of physical KRS context consumption
scope: research only; no ADOPTED qualification, Production policy, source signature, OOS or ticket authority
required_before_adoption: fresh current context beyond historical proxies
separate KRS physical mapping review if desired
falsification: increment disappears under context ablation on future held-out races
conditional Pair/Third fails incremental role/coverage control
proxy congestion has opposite out-of-day effect
wrong corner assumptions or distance fallback inflate measured coverage
unknown protection wrongly treated as weak
rollback: stop calling this isolated module; preserve originals; no change to current KAW Owner/Registry/Gateway/Signer
